news.title: 日媒试玩《昭和米国物语》:爽！又有点不太对劲
news.summary: 日本游戏媒体Automaton提前体验了《昭和米国物语》

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260930209241.png
受bilibili“游先看”线下试玩会邀请，日本游戏媒体Automaton提前体验了 《昭和米国物语》 这款备受期待的作品。试玩版分为4个不同切片，依次展现了游戏的故事流程、营地日常、半开放世界探索以及战斗环节等核心要素。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260923591417.png
游戏设定在昭和66年，日本泡沫经济并未破灭，如日中天的日本人买下了美国的大片土地，让美洲大陆成为日本经济与文化的新殖民地。玩家扮演死而复生的少女千草蝶子，为了寻找妹妹而踏上横穿美国的旅程。制作人罗翔宇是80后，经历过日美文化作品大量冲击国内的童年，《昭和米国物语》更像是他对童年记忆的一次幻想型改编，里面有大量老作品的彩蛋，甚至包含一些中国玩家能够秒懂的东西。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260924071492.png

战斗部分上手门槛极低，但打击感扎实，Automaton用“爽”字来总结战斗感受。玩家的攻击方式取决于武器选择，包括近战拳套、武士刀、双持美利坚国旗杆、远程霰弹枪以及备受期待的钻头等。战斗的基础逻辑是打出连招积攒怒气，怒气攻击可大幅提升伤害并瞬间回满耐力，同时让敌人更快积攒崩溃条，在适当时机发动奥义完成循环。钻头武器灵感并非来自“天元突破”，而是《盖塔机器人》的盖塔2号，并融合了《勇者王》等钻头元素，称赞“钻头果然是男人的浪漫”。其他武器的演出效果也相当华丽，动作流畅性高，命中后的手感明显，有的奥义看一次笑一次。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260924171187.png

“红莲号”旅行车是玩家的基地，可以进行吃饭、品酒、读书、健身小游戏、泡澡等日常活动来强化角色，每个活动都伴有相应的角色演出。旅行车内还有装饰系统，可以把获得的物品挂到墙上，预计是一个庞大的收集要素。新横滨山商业街的探索部分包含购物、小游戏、分支任务和NPC互动等内容，场景中隐藏着宝箱，还有一个分支任务是寻找自行车并拔掉气门芯，甚至为此做了拔气门芯的小游戏，还加入了路人的警戒值系统。商业街还包含一段拜访“村山汤屋”的剧情，充满了制作组对中日美三国文化的思辨性。

金门大桥的BOSS战是试玩版中最精彩的部分，这场持久战融合了剧情演绎、逃亡追逐和无厘头的QTE玩法，开发团队几乎无时无刻不在玩梗和整活。编辑形容游戏是“一场半开放世界的复古公路电影，只不过这场电影亦真亦幻，哪里都不太对劲罢了”。不过他也指出，一些演出动作上的衔接尚未打磨完善，战斗难度曲线、剧情编排以及半开放世界的探索深度，仅凭试玩版还难以窥探全貌。但无论如何，当可以玩到完整版的那一天到来时，他会放下手边所有的事情去全身心体验这款游戏。

news.title: 米哈游开场公布《源初之结》，《无限大》定档：gamescom 2026开幕夜
news.summary: 北京时间8月26日凌晨，gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live正式举行。 开场时，主持人Geoff Keighley谈到了过去一年游戏行业的变化。他表示，电子游戏和整个行业都在不断发展，这既令人

content.v: 北京时间8月26日凌晨，gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live正式举行。
开场时，主持人Geoff Keighley谈到了过去一年游戏行业的变化。他表示，电子游戏和整个行业都在不断发展，这既令人兴奋，也让人感到有些“可怕”——几乎每周都能看到裁员和工作室关闭的新闻，而存储、内存等硬件成本的上涨，也让购买游戏设备变得比过去更加昂贵。
但与此同时，世界各地的开发者仍然在继续制作新游戏，无论是大型团队、小型独立团队，还是来自世界各地的团队。
随后，米哈游的新作《源初之结》（Nodusfall）成为本届Opening Night Live第一个公布的游戏。
■ 米哈游公布《源初之结》
米哈游在本次Opening Night Live开场公布了新作《源初之结》（NODUSFALL）。
《源初之结》是一款奇幻写实风格的合作动作游戏。游戏发生在“诗与传说都尚未开始”的古远时代。玩家扮演的“织者”将追寻劫难源头，从大千世界启程，探索奇观异象、结识英雄豪杰，并挑战凶神恶兽，逐渐揭开“神明余晖”下的真相，也一步步“拼回破碎的自己”。
游戏采用了与米哈游以往作品明显不同的黑暗奇幻风格，首支预告展示了巨龙、凤凰以及其他大型生物，玩家手持刀剑等武器，与体型远超自己的敌人战斗。
当PV画面中熟悉的HoYoverse Logo出现时，现场随即爆发出一阵欢呼。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/9896a8e3e4bc4c44.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 《无限大》定档
网易旗下Naked Rain开发的《无限大ANANTA》带来了新的剧情预告，并确定于2027年1月15日全球上线，将登陆PC、PS5和移动端。
预告首次公开了游戏中的第二座主要城市“重霄”，这座城市参考了上海、杭州等亚洲都市。玩家可以在多个可操作角色之间切换，从巡察官、黑客到配送员等不同身份体验城市生活，每个角色拥有不同的探索和战斗方式。
新PV中，游戏继续展示了城市探索、载具、跑酷与战斗等内容，同时埋入了不少向经典电影致敬的彩蛋，包括《蜘蛛侠》等作品。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/9896a8e3e7e9b623.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 《湮灭之潮》继续展示
国产单机买断制游戏《湮灭之潮》在本次Opening Night Live中公开了首支剧情预告。游戏目前计划登陆PC与主机平台，发售时间尚未公布。
游戏以遭到“异世界”入侵的现代伦敦为舞台，现实与幻想世界交错。玩家将扮演灾难中的幸存者Gwendolyn，在寻找家人、调查入侵真相的同时，试图修复已经破碎的世界。
战斗依然是游戏的重要部分。Gwendolyn可以召唤来自亚瑟王传说的圆桌骑士，不同骑士拥有不同能力；此外，游戏中还会出现巨大的“巨像骑士”，玩家可以攀爬它们的身体展开战斗。
Angela Sant’Albano将为Gwendolyn配音，她此前曾出演《Resident Evil Requiem》中的Grace。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/2986a8e3ea46b57e.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 《星布谷地》将于今年冬季上线
除了开场公布的《源初之结》，米哈游还在本次Opening Night Live中带来了《星布谷地》的新预告，计划于2026年冬季上线。
这也是米哈游第一次正式尝试生活模拟类型，《星布谷地》主打星球生活模拟，玩家可以种植、钓鱼、赶海、烹饪、建造家园，也能探索星海、与其他玩家互动。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/2916a8e3ed1ab206.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 《异克斯小队》：去外星打工
《黎明杀机》开发商Behaviour Interactive带来了三人合作PVE射击游戏《异克斯小队》（Exterminauts），国内由腾讯游戏发行。游戏预计于2027年登陆PC、PS5和Xbox Series X|S，目前已经开放愿望单。
玩家将在外星球“天穹星”上扮演异星灭害专员，负责清除外星生物、维修设施、处理突发事件，再带着战利品撤离。
简单来说，这是一个“外星打工模拟器”，只不过你的同事、客户和工地都有可能要你的命。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/2606a8e3f15e41b3.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 《彩虹六号》变成回合制
育碧公布了《彩虹六号：战术行动》（Rainbow Six Tactics），这是一款单人回合制战术游戏。
游戏与《彩虹六号：围攻》的时间线相连，玩家将扮演Rainbow指挥官Six，从15名干员中挑选4人组成小队，完成救援人质、拆除炸弹等任务。战斗中还保留了《围攻》的可破坏环境，并加入了可以提前规划协同突入的“Breach Planning”机制。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/2576a8e3f347253a.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 《最终幻想》导演登台介绍
《最终幻想 VII REVELATION》带来了新的Gameplay预告，这是《最终幻想VII》重制系列的第三部，预计于2027年春季登陆PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Switch 2和PC。
这次预告的主角是系列经典敌人Weapons。Ruby Weapon、Emerald Weapon和Ultima Weapon悉数登场，玩家将与这些巨型生物展开战斗，其中还首次展示了水下对战Emerald Weapon的场景。Highwind也不再只是交通工具，预告展示了空中的战斗场面。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/2816a8e3f9f113c9.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 《巫师3》新DLC
CD Projekt Red公布了《巫师3：狂猎》重制版以及全新扩展《The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Songs of the Past》，这也是《巫师3》在《血与酒》之后时隔多年再次推出大型扩展。
重制版将于2026年9月29日推出，除了提升画面和战斗、重新设计技能树，还将包含《石之心》和《血与酒》两个大型扩展，并首次登陆Switch 2。对于已经拥有游戏的玩家，这次更新将免费提供。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/6096a8e3fd41f73d.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
此外，《Train Sim World 7》、《Pony Island 2: Panda Circus》、《Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake》、《Crazy Taxi》等游戏也在本次Opening Night Live中亮相。
两个多小时的直播里，国产游戏依然占据了相当多的篇幅，而《战争机器》、《最终幻想VII》、《巫师3》等熟悉的名字也带来了新消息。
Opening Night Live结束了，但gamescom才刚刚开始。接下来几天，触乐也会继续从科隆现场带回更多内容。

content.v: 在今日举行的科隆游戏展上，由《上行战场》开发商Neon Giant打造、韩国KRAFTON发行的赛博朋克风第一人称射击RPG《NO LAW》发布了全新宣传视频。
视频：
视频带领玩家再次走进虚构城市“欲望港”（Port Desire），呈现了一个充满黑色电影质感的赛博世界——每一个选择都将带来后果，种什么因得什么果。
官方此前曾确认，本作首要定位是高端（Premium）单机游戏，购买即获得完整故事。
《NO LAW》是一款单人沉浸式开放世界FPS RPG，预计登陆PC、PS5及Xbox Series X|S平台。游戏背景设定于危险密布的欲望港街头，玩家将扮演前士兵格雷·哈克（Grey Harker），被卷入一场本以为已逃离的旧日生活。这座城市对他的认知仅限于流言：艺术家、幽灵、推土机、战术家——也有人称他为“园丁”。
玩家可通过战斗、渗透、威吓或开辟自己的道路，追捕城中腐败的“市长们”。游戏世界充满高度互动性——多个敌对派系、危险角色与待展开的故事交织于其中。正如官方描述所言：“在欲望港，没有干净的选择、没有简单的规则，也没有任何法律保护你。”
《NO LAW》的具体发售日期尚未公布，游戏计划2027年发售。

news.title: 巫师3旧时曲官方介绍来了：杰洛特将赌上性命！
news.summary: “旧时曲”是《巫师3：狂猎》在“血与酒”发布近10年后将推出的全新DLC，确认于2027年正式推出，登陆PC、Xbox与PS5平台。

content.v: “旧时曲”是《巫师3：狂猎》在“血与酒”发布近10年后将推出的全新DLC，确认于2027年正式推出，登陆PC、Xbox与PS5平台。
在今天凌晨的科隆游戏展开幕夜上，CDPR官方公布了“旧时曲”的全新宣传片，展示了游戏的部分战斗、剧情等内容。
视频欣赏：
与此同时，游戏的Steam商店也迎来了一次更新，官方展开介绍了“旧时曲”的大致内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260901182628.jpg
官方表示，在“旧时曲”中，杰洛特来到了雷天哈普。这片如诗如画的土地上潜藏着黑暗的秘密。凭借独特的突变诱发物和新武器锁链，杰洛特必须战胜前所未见的敌人，击败沉睡已久的邪恶力量。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260902322218.png
玩家需要在故事剧情中做出选择并承担相应的后果。为此，“ 杰洛特不光要赌上自己的性命 ”，还有整片大陆的未来，甚至是他最珍视的友谊。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260902428541.jpg

利维亚的杰洛特闪亮回归 —— 大名鼎鼎的怪物克星利维亚的杰洛特重返猎魔人之路。使用独特的突变诱发物，掌握新的武器，再一次展开冒险。 探索新的区域 —— 风景如画的雷天哈普到处是故事和秘密等着人们去发现。其中也包括隐藏在这片土地深处的罪恶力量。 体验史诗任务 —— 有史以来最畅销的角色扮演游戏之一新增数小时的游戏时长，几十个新的任务、关键地点及众多内容在等着你。 揭开超自然谜团 —— 和杰洛特一起追查位于雷天哈普腹地的黑暗诅咒，体验原汁原味的《巫师》剧情：做出你的选择，承担相应的后果。 探索重制后的内容 —— 通过《巫师 3：狂猎》重制版畅享更新后的玩法、性能、角色成长等更多内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260902225813.png

news.title: 《昭和米国物语》试玩前瞻：一场荒诞热闹的美国公路之旅

content.v: “80年代末的日本买下了美国大部分土地”，光是听到这样一句世界观设定，就很难不对《昭和米国物语》产生好奇。
在这个架空世界里，日本不只是完成了对美国土地的经济收购，更进一步完成了文化层面的“殖民”。于是，原本属于美国的公路、城市、商业街乃至生活方式，都被塞进了大量浓烈的昭和日本元素。日本泡沫经济时代的繁华想象、美国公路文化、僵尸末日般的荒诞氛围，以及各种令人难以预测的流行文化梗混杂在一起，最终构成了一个既熟悉又陌生、既荒诞又自洽的“昭和米国”。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826085257-9088-27093.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
本作最早于2022年1月公布，原定2025年发售，后于2025年11月宣布延期至2026年，目前游戏确定登陆PS5与PC平台，并将于8月26日至30日参加gamescom 2026，带来现场试玩及全新预告。

我们日前也受邀参加了本作日前在bilibili游先看活动中举办的线下试玩会。此次试玩会共提供四个不同的游戏切片，分别涵盖了短暂的线性流程与基础战斗、旅行车营地的休息成长系统、较为开放区域的自由探索，以及一场完整的大型BOSS战。基本能较为全面地体验到这款作品想要呈现的核心玩法：它既是一款以剧情为主轴的RPG，也有着明确的战斗系统，但最令人印象深刻的，依然是那个几乎渗透到每一个细节里的“昭和米国式荒诞”。
“个个都是人才，说话又好听”
游戏中，玩家扮演的主角千草蝶子，是一位死而复生的少女，为了寻找妹妹彩的下落，蝶子决定前往新横滨山拜访平安婆婆，但一伙勇士团土匪已经抢先一步抵达。试玩实际体验下来，最让人感受到的可能反而并不是战斗，而是本作丰富有趣的文本内容。

无论是道路上的普通NPC、还是各种敌人，都有着丰富台词。尤其是敌人的对话，很容易让人产生一种“里面个个都是人才，说话又好听”的奇妙感觉。游戏并没有把普通杂兵单纯作为等待玩家清理的数值单位使用，而是在他们身上也塞进了大量符合世界观的胡闹台词和个性化内容。突然张嘴萌妹音的土匪、在路边烤乳猪式大烤活人的精英怪……推进过程中不断有奇怪的信息进入视野，整个世界似乎一直在提醒玩家：“这里确实是美国，但又绝对不是你认识的那个美国。”
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826085257-7192-66466.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
四种武器，四种完全不同的胡闹方式

此次试玩，主要提供了拳套、武士刀、螺旋钻头和米国国旗四种武器，每种武器攻击模组各异，玩家可以通过组合轻重击来派生出不同攻击，派生攻击除了伤害更高之外，还可以打断敌人大部分招式。通过“怒气系统”，不同武器之间的个性进一步被放大。游戏中，怒气会通过有效攻击以及受到攻击积累，每满100点可以获得一个怒气点数，消耗怒气点数后，可以强化攻击招式，将普通重攻击转为更加强力的怒气攻击，不同武器的怒气攻击自然也是各具特色，而且发动怒气攻击时可以瞬间恢复耐力至满。
这一套让战斗资源之间形成了一定的循环：近战、闪避等行为会消耗耐力，而耐力越低，玩家的防御力也越低，但不断攻击或被打，可以积攒怒气资源，通过怒气攻击能重新获得一波进攻能力，并补满耐力资源。

而四把武器最能彰显各具特色、各有“搞头”的还是它们的奥义演出，武士刀属于相对传统的一类，奥义演出也更接近玩家对于动作游戏必杀技的常规想象。而钻头和国旗显然就开始彻底放飞了，钻头能够使出堪称“千年杀”的攻击，国旗奥义更是会把敌人字面意义上的发射升空，随后进入“全体敬礼目送”的离谱场面。如果说传统ARPG武器设计通常强调攻击距离、速度、伤害和招式差异，那本作显然还增加了一项非常重要的标准：“有没有乐子”。比起攻略效率，玩家可能会为了看看某把武器究竟还能整出什么新活，而主动去尝试不同的装备。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826085338-2671-10206.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

当然本作也有着作为ARPG来说比较完备的动作战斗系统框架，首先是精准回避，通过精准回避敌人攻击可以有效进行反击。然后是武器切换与连携攻击系统，玩家可以预先配置近战和远程武器，通过十字键在战斗中切换，如果在攻击状态下使用R1搭配十字键，能够直接切换武器并发动特殊的连携攻击。不断攻击敌人能够积累其“崩溃量表”，当量表积满后，敌人会进入防备大幅下降的崩溃状态，此时，敌人受到的伤害会加倍，玩家靠近后还可以发动处决攻击，快速解决敌人的同时回复少量生命值。
从这些系统看出，游戏希望玩家并不是始终拿着一把武器从头砍到尾，更鼓励大家去尝试切换不同武器，从而获得多种多样的欢乐，如果正式版可以体验的武器种类更加丰富，那想必节目效果直接拉满。
在荒诞世界闯荡
第二个与第三个试玩切片分别演示了旅行中的营地休息与成长，以及在一片较为开放区域的自由探索。
蝶子的爱车“红莲号”并不只是一个交通工具，更是玩家在这场旅途中的家。从试玩来看，这部分承担了比较传统的RPG成长与修整功能，同时也贴合“公路旅行”这一主题。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826085258-8685-69421.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
在新横滨山的自由探索，也是充分表现本作世界观的一段。游戏虽然充满各种日式风情，但在这里的温泉却莫名洋溢着一股浓厚的……“重庆气息”？因为泡的根本不是普通的温泉水，而是各种各样的火锅。最后蝶子泡在一个九宫格火锅中，一边享受“温泉”，一边思考人生。
这个场面就是本作世界观很好的一个缩影，你觉得它好像很日本，但下一秒它似乎又有些美国味儿；你以为终于进入一个福利温泉泡澡场景，结果发现温泉里煮的是火锅底料；你觉得这一切已经很胡闹了，游戏却又在这让主角思考沉重的剧情。荒诞与严肃并存，而且两者谁也不觉得自己和对方冲突。
连续电影式的BOSS战
如果说前三个切片主要展示都是基础玩法，第四个切片无疑是本次试玩中最具总结“压轴”感的内容。蝶子一路追赶黑衣人，最终来到金门大桥，面对曾经杀死自己的仇人，一场月光下的生死搏杀正式开始。
这并非打一管血就结束的普通BOSS战，而是一场由多个阶段连续组成的大型战斗。BOSS拥有多条血槽，每削完一条血，就会插入一段剧情演出，随后切换新的战斗场地，BOSS的攻击方式也会发生些许变化，整个流程时长近30分钟。剧情则以一种定格式连续演出的形式呈现。同样比起战斗的难度和机制，我还是更被这场的“味道”所吸引注意。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826085258-4915-63925.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
对方从外表上乍一看确实有着忍者风采，但标志性的昭和不良少年式飞机头又显得那么出戏。攻击方式也确实拥有不少忍者元素，但实际交手又会发现，这都是什么脑洞清奇的“很忍者，但又非常不忍者”的招式。你永远可以从他动作、言语中看出某种传统文化符号，但开发团队又总能在下一秒把这个符号拧到一个完全意想不到的方向。

除了BOSS战的几个大型演出外，试玩过程中其实还能感受到《昭和米国物语》在镜头设计上也花了不少心思，例如在第三个切片新横滨山爬山流程里，就通过镜头演出与环境构图，让本来可能单调的跑路多了一些视觉上的趣味。这种小巧思未必会是玩家重点留意的地方，但对于一款强调独特风格的游戏来说还是很重要的。因为本作最突出的卖点，本来就是它的世界与气质，它能够在初发表时凭借宣传片就让无数国内外玩家觉得“这游戏有点意思”，原因也在于此。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826085258-6235-68361.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
仍有提升空间
当然，经过四个切片的体验之后，也能明显感受到《昭和米国物语》目前仍然存在需要继续打磨的地方。

最直接的一点，就是动作部分的操作手感，从系统设计上来说，本作已经有用近战轻重攻击、派生攻击、精准回避、怒气、崩溃、奥义等相当丰富的内容。理论上，这套系统能够让玩家进行很多不同的组合。不过体验实际操作中，连招之间的衔接感、回避操作的时机与反馈，以及整体动作的流畅程度，仍然有进一步提升的空间。毕竟对于一款ARPG来说，这方面还是相当关键的。如果最基础的攻击与回避，没法给玩家足够清晰、及时、顺畅的反馈，那么一些设计得很有意思的进阶机制，乃至演出也会受到一定影响。
当然试玩版的内容毕竟与正式版存在差异，游戏整体仍然处于打磨阶段，因此，现阶段对于操作手感的评价，更多还是希望开发团队能够在最后阶段持续进行优化。毕竟这里已经有一个足够特别的世界，如果能再让战斗爽一点，那么整体体验显然会再提升一个层次。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826085259-5731-79842.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
A9VG体验总结
目前来看，本作最大的优势依然是风格独特，不仅只停在文字设定上的“日本买下美国”来博人眼球，它的那种荒诞味道确实被贯彻到了各个层面，让人很期待这个世界到底还有多少离谱玩意儿。至于最终能否把这些丰富的“乐子”，全部转化成一场真正顺畅又令人难忘的RPG冒险，就要等待正式版给出答案了。

news.title: Showa American Story: The First Hands-On Preview
news.summary: Showa American Story succeeds in crafting an unforgettable, eccentric B-movie world. However, its deliberate j

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/new01-1787682463105.png
Key Preview Takeaways:

Showa American Story is, if nothing else, a profoundly wacky action-RPG. Five years have passed since its initial reveal in 2021, and with barely any updates in recent years, players have been left wondering: In an era where the Chinese AAA single-player market is rapidly expanding, can a game with such an eccentric tone actually carve out its own identity?

We recently had the chance to go hands-on with about two hours of Showa American Story. Based on an introduction by Creative Director Xiangyu Luo and our own gameplay experience, here is what makes this absurd adventure tick. Luo describes Showa American Story as an RPG overflowing with retro pop culture. Set in an alternate late-'80s where Japan bought up most of the United States, effectively colonizing it economically and culturally, players take control of Choko Chigusa—a girl brought back from the dead. She embarks on a road trip filled with combat, exploration, and growth across a world that feels both absurdly bizarre and weirdly familiar.

Our demo was split into four segments: a linear story-and-combat section, a camp exploration slice focused on rest and character progression, an open-map exploration sequence, and a massive boss fight.

Combat in Showa American Story integrates elements from various action game staples, as Choko can use both melee and ranged weapons. The demo featured four types of melee weapons—Bare Hands/Gauntlets, Katanas, Drills, and Polearms—alongside ranged options like shotguns and assault rifles. Every melee weapon comes with a specific name. For instance, the katana category consists entirely of historical legendary blades; I found one called "Mikazuki Munechika" lying around. You can actually equip it, though the item description hilariously notes it's probably just a fake.

Weapon categories boast intensely edgy, anime-style move names and wildly different playstyles: Bare Hands: Beyond basic fists, you can equip gauntlets, brass knuckles, and even "Wolf Fang Vajra Claws"—which look exactly like Wolverine's iconic claws. They offer the highest attack speed, but naturally, the lowest damage. Katana: This category has the deepest moveset. Depending on your light and heavy attack combos, Choko shifts into different "Stances" (Kamae), offering branching attack paths for your next move. Light + Heavy triggers "High Stance," Light + Light + Heavy initiates "Yin-Yang Stance," and a single Heavy attack results in "Matsukaze Stance." There's even a long combo (four Lights, three Heavies) that unleashes a "Reversed Hasso Stance" capable of parrying, while double Heavy puts you in a "Fudoshin (Immovable Mind) Stance." Polearms: The demo let us wield a literal American flag as a dual-handed weapon. It excels at wide-sweeping attacks and grants Super Armor. While it struggles to instantly break enemies, it easily knocks them down. The trade-off is massive stamina consumption, which can be mitigated through upgrades. And Drills: Harder to master. The attacks are mostly linear and restrict your ability to sprint, but the damage is astronomical. The linear thrusts pierce through enemies, and using a Rage Attack drastically shortens the weapon's long wind-up animation while leaving a lingering cyclone for continuous multi-hit damage.

The core of the combat revolves around a strategic "Rage Cycle." Dealing or taking damage builds the Rage meter. Once enough is gathered, it converts into a "Rage Point" (currently capped at 5). Weapon types generate Rage at drastically different rates; barehanded weapons build it the fastest. Therefore, swapping to fists when you're starved for resources is the optimal play. Even within a category, there are nuances—gauntlets deal less damage than brass knuckles but build Rage faster.

Rage Points dictate the flow of combat and can be spent in several ways: Ultimates: Consume multiple points for massive damage (3 points for barehanded, 5 points for katanas). Rage Attacks: Holding R1 and pressing Triangle turns your standard heavy attack into a stronger Rage variant. Katanas gain extended reach, while Drills inflict longer sustained damage. Chain Attacks: Similar to the "Flash Attack" in the Nioh series. Pressing R1 and the D-pad corresponding to another melee weapon during an attack consumes 1 Rage Point to instantly swap weapons and unleash a high-damage follow-up with zero recovery frames. Swapping to a firearm triggers Bullet Time and exposes enemy weak points. Standard weapon swapping is notoriously slow, making Chain Attacks the most effective way to juggle your arsenal. Perfect Dodge & Super Recovery: Holding R1 + Dodge at any time spends 1 point for a Perfect Dodge; subsequently pressing the attack button unleashes a Melee Chain or Ranged Chain. Alternatively, getting hit by a heavy attack triggers a brief slow-motion window; pressing dodge here burns 1 point for a "Super Recovery," and pressing attack immediately after automatically fires off a Melee Counter or Ranged Counter.

Rage and Chain attacks quickly deplete an enemy's stamina. Once they are broken, you can perform an Execution. Thus, the ideal combat loop looks like this: quickly build Rage, spend it for high damage or Ultimates, but always keep 1 point in the tank to seamlessly swap back to fists to rebuild your meter. It requires intense focus and resource management.

Alongside Rage, Stamina deeply impacts the pacing. Regular light attacks consume Stamina (especially heavy weapons like the flag). Since Showa often throws Dynasty Warriors-sized hordes at you, this stamina cost can feel restricting early on. However, the stamina penalty isn't overly harsh. Running out of stamina doesn't leave you paralyzed; instead, it drops your defense, causing you to take significantly more damage. Interestingly, this loops back into the Rage Cycle: landing a Rage Attack restores Stamina. So, mindless button-mashing will get you killed. You have to weave Rage Attacks into your combos before your stamina depletes to stay healthy.

That said, the combat feel and enemy interactions are currently quite rough. First, the hit-stop on melee strikes is overly pronounced, making the combat feel sluggish rather than impactful. Second, there's very little actual interaction between the player and enemies—it often feels like both sides are just swinging through each other. Choko has very low poise and gets staggered easily, yet enemy attack timings are incredibly difficult to read. The Perfect Dodge window is especially baffling; sometimes you need to dodge before an attack even connects, and other times it feels like you have to get hit first to trigger it.

These clunky interactions often derail the "Rage Cycle." Because enemy attacks are unpredictable, players tend to panic-roll when hit. This accidentally triggers Super Recoveries, instantly draining your hard-earned Rage meter and putting you on the back foot. Furthermore, the game’s visual presentation—particularly blood and combat effects—can be overwhelming to the point of distraction, leading to visual and operational experiences that are currently a bit underwhelming.

news.title: Humankind 2 trailer accused of being 'AI slop,' studio says nope: 'real actors, practical sets, and custom-made props'
news.summary: The uncanny trailer shows the perspective of infants through space and time.

content.v: Humankind 2 was announced today at Gamescom's Opening Night Live showcase , and I have to admit that I was among those who raised an eyebrow at the reveal trailer and wondered: Is this AI generated? A number of commenters speculated that it was.
Nope, says the studio.

"The Humankind 2 live-action announcement trailer was filmed at Nu Boyana Film Studios in Sofia using real actors, practical sets, and custom-made props created specifically for the production," developer Amplitude Studios told PC Gamer over email. "We will be sharing behind-the-scenes images from the shoot soon."
PC Gamer has seen a few of those photos, and they do indeed show actors on a sound stage with partial sets and a typical blue backdrop for compositing.

In my and the internet's defense, the trailer does have something of an AI look to it. From the fisheye perspective of recently-birthed infants, we're stared at uncannily by a prehistoric woman, a hollering Viking aboard a longship, an American settler in a wagon, and other new parents from throughout space and time.

In the backgrounds: a giant tornado, bandits on horseback, a nuclear explosion, outer space. The studio hasn't commented on how those special effects were created, but they may well just be old fashioned CGI. I've asked for clarification on that point.

As for the game, the first Humankind was decent—Fraser described it as "a solid 4X that could use a bit more personality" in his review —and the sequel will introduce "new progression systems, innovative features, enhanced visuals, a modernized UI, and gameplay improvements," according to Amplitude.
Humankind 2 will release on PC in 2027, and there's a Steam page with more information live now.

news.title: Konami Partners With Celebrity Kitty to Release Metal Gear Cat Toys at CatCon 2026
news.summary: Konami is partnering up with a celebrity kitty named ‘one-eared Uno’ to debut a special Metal Gear cat toy col

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/metal-gear-cat-toys-1787697602555.jpg
Konami is partnering up with a celebrity kitty named ‘one-eared Uno’ to debut a special Metal Gear cat toy collection available at CatCon 2026.

If you didn’t know there was a cat convention, now you do. CatCon is a yearly event that brings together cat lovers from all over the globe to Pasadena, California, featuring special exhibits, workshops, adoption drives, and meet-and-greets with celebrity cats.

One of those cats, affectionately named ‘one-eared Uno,’ and her owner, Kat Curtis, will host a special meet-and-greet event at the Konami booth at CatCon this year to celebrate the release of some special Metal Gear-themed cat toys.

These offerings include cat scratch boxes modeled after the iconic cardboard boxes that Big Boss and Old Snake use to sneak around without being detected by enemies, plush pet toys, and even cat collars inspired by Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots .

The lovable one-eared Uno with her adorable underbite was rescued by Kat as a stray, who found the kitty abandoned near a dumpster. The two now boast over five million followers on social media and are meeting fans at Catcon on October 12 at 2 PM PST.

CatCon takes place at the Pasadena Convention Center from October 10 - 11. Cat lovers will be able to score the Snake-approved merch for their kitties on those days only, both at the convention and online via the OKS Gear Shop.

What’s more, fans can win a chance to meet Uno at CatCon and get the exclusive Metal Gear merch if they visit the Konami booth at the convention and either: show they own the Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2, add the collection to their wishlist, or purchase the Metal Gear merchandise at the booth.

This collaboration might be off the wall, but given the sheer amount of absurdities that take place within the series, we can’t say that this partnership is totally out of left field. This limited-time partnership marks the launch of the Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 , a compilation of the classic stealth-action games that releases on August 17, 2026 for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, and Steam.

news.title: The First New Magic Puzzle of 2026 Is Now Available at Retailers

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/the-spooky-shire-1787681008352.png

The first of the Series 6 Magic Puzzle Company puzzles is now available to buy at Amazon and Target. The Spooky Shire isn't even listed on the company's website yet, so it appears to be making its retail debut a bit early.

The Spooky Shire features original art from Kasey White and depicts a colorful scene full of ghosts, witches, skeletons, and a ton of cute little pumpkins. Like all Magic puzzles, it's made up of 1,000 pieces.

If you aren't already familiar with the Magic Puzzle Company , It's pretty easy to explain why its one of the best puzzle brands out there. The pieces are unique, the art is always incredible (not AI generated), and there's always a magical surpise waiting for you at the end.

These puzzles are also just really fun to put together. There's so many different things going on in each scene, which makes every newly added piece feel special. According to the product page, there are over 50 easter eggs to find as you put the puzzle together. You also get two art posters you can use as a reference.
When Will There Be More Series 6 Puzzles

It's hard to say exactly when the other two Series 6 puzzles will arrive, but it likely won't be any time soon. The first new Series 5 puzzle was released in August 2025 , but the rest weren't made available until January 2026 . If the company follows a similar pattern for its latest series, you can expect the next two puzzles to arrive sometime in early 2027.

news.title: Metro 2039 gameplay trailer looks like bad news for your aging graphics card
news.summary: My gut says a regular PC will not like this game.

content.v: The latest trailer for Metro 2039 tried to get a scare out of me with its radiation-sickened bugs and monsters jumping at the screen, but the spookiest thing about it is how gosh darn good it looks.

I'm not talking specifically about the gameplay, which this trailer does show more of—gun customization, mask wiping, stealth kills, the Metro hits—but the graphics. 4A has always been one for graphical showpieces (Metro Exodus was an early adopter of full ray tracing), but Metro 2039 is a significant step up in the realm of photoreal.

It's got that high-frequency detail and soft lighting that, at times, makes outdoor spaces look like straight-up photographs. Which begs the question: will a normal person's computer be able to run this thing?

That question wouldn't usually be top of mind, except, well, we're deep into a hardware crisis that shows no signs of stopping. Powerful PC hardware is almost impossible to reasonably obtain, a sad reality that has some of us embracing the great Tech Pause .

Metro 2039's flexibility will come down to how much worse you're allowed to make it look, and there is some good news here: It's a console game, ya'll. That means somehow, 4A will have it running on an Xbox Series S, the low benchmark for modern consoles. Does that mean mid-range PC owners will be happy with how it performs? Less likely: Anything less than a locked 60 fps is a hard sell for a shooter these days.
But I offer another ray of hope: 4A uses a proprietary engine helmed by experienced engineers, so it could be a smoother ride than we've come to expect from realistic-looking Unreal 5 joints.
Metro 2039 has no release date yet, but if you can pop over to Germany, 4A has a playable demo at Gamescom this week.

news.title: Tarae: The Unbound is an 'Eastern dark fantasy' action RPG, and I for one am here for K-Diablo
news.summary: Featuring one of my favorite ARPG class archetypes: Guy With Gun.

content.v: It brings me no joy to admit this, but recently I've begun thinking that I'm finally nearing my fill of ARPGs. I've gotten a lot of great years out of clicking a mouse button and exploding full screens of skeletons, but the prospect doesn't quite spark joy like it used to.
Or at least that's what I thought until roughly 45 minutes ago, when I saw the announcement trailer for Tarae: The Unbound that had been slipped into a Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live Montage.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pzztdA8kLNyyvJuyrEU9kM.jpg

The problem, I now realize, is that I've mostly spent my time with ARPGs looking at the same kinds of things. Most games downstream of Diablo tend to flow into the same basin of interchangeable demons, dark cultists, and piles of weird meat. But looking at the brief clips of Tarae, I realize now I'd just been aching for a jolt to the ARPG aesthetic palette.

Developed by Boundary and published by Krafton, Tarae's Steam page says it's set in "a world that reimagines Eastern myth, folklore, and traditional aesthetics, where beauty and mystery are entwined with darkness and brutality." It shows in the listings screenshots and embedded gifs, where enemies are being fought in Buddhist temples and player characters are battling bosses with hauntingly distended features plucked from East Asian monster illustrations.

If that's not enough, Tarae: The Unbound also includes one of my favorite character class conceits: Just an old guy with a matchlock gun. Although this particular handgunner seems to know something I don't about how historic firearms work, because he's able to pump out rapid fire gouts of firebomb explosives. Good for him.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gwbBCnAx4a5r9sxTwvV7LT.jpg

From the sounds of it, Boundary is aiming to offer a variety of buildcrafting systems: "The balance and conflict of the Five Elements, the harmony of Yin and Yang, karma and the cycle of reincarnation all shape your leveling, equipment, and combat style," the developer says. "Even within a single class, different choices lead to entirely different builds."

I can't begin to guess how that will all work in practice, but I'm eager to experience our K-Diablo future when the time comes. It likely won't be for a bit, however: Tarae: The Unbound doesn't have a release date, unlike the full release of Path of Exile 2 now pegged for December 11 , but you can wishlist it on Steam now.

news.title: Sea of Remnants Director Reveals 10 Minutes of Exclusive Gameplay, Details the Game’s Hidden Secrets
news.summary: Watch 10 exclusive minutes of Sea of Remnants gameplay as the game's creative director details the RPG's rogue

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/seaofremnants-gameplay-blogroll-1787580343882.jpg

When Sea of Remnants releases next year, it promises a free-to-play role playing experience where you’ll be able to both hit the open water on a variety of swashbuckling turn-based missions and explore land-based missions in the game’s fictional setting of Orbtopia. And now, after the release of a brand-new trailer during gamescom 2026’s Opening Night Live, IGN can exclusively reveal more than 10 minutes of gameplay, which you can see in the player above.

Sea of Remnants is being developed by Joker Studios and published by NetEase Games, who recently recently-announced a closed beta test coming this December. Ahead of Opening Night Live, I sat down with the game’s Creative Director, who goes by the name Alfie, to break down the new gameplay and dive into what secrets await for players when the game comes out in 2027.
Sea of Remnants Creative Director breaks down new exclusive gameplay and the game’s mechanics.
IGN: What specific mechanics or moments in the exclusive gameplay should we be paying the most attention to.

Alfie: There are three elements that I believe are particularly distinctive. First is the game’s roguelike structure. By combining roguelike progression with turn-based combat and dice mechanics, battles become filled with unpredictability and possibility. We also hope players will pay attention to the music as they experience the game. We have put considerable thought into creating distinct musical atmospheres for voyages at sea, exploration across the islands, combat, and many other situations. Finally, each week, players may discover a new crew member within the world of Sea of Remnants. We want each reunion during a Forgotten Voyage to feel like finding one of your companions all over again. At the same time, every additional crew member introduces new team compositions and combinations, making the roguelike loop richer and opening up even more possibilities.
IGN: What is one mechanic or surprise in Sea of Remnants that you think will genuinely catch players off guard?

Alfie: Sea of Remnants is filled with small details and hidden interactions that we hope players will discover for themselves. For example, if you come across an unassuming lounge chair somewhere in the open world, try sitting down. For a moment, you may forget everything else and simply enjoy the peace and quiet. If I had to choose one genuine surprise, however, it would be the opportunity to discover a crew member each week. Sometimes I may be hoping to find Crew Member A, only to encounter Crew Member B instead. That may disrupt my original plan, but it can also open up entirely new possibilities.
IGN: What does the dual ocean and land settings mean for world-building?

Alfie : Creating an ocean-fantasy world has undoubtedly been one of our greatest challenges. The genre is inherently mysterious, and everyone has their own idea of what it might look like. We spent a long time considering how to distinguish our game and build an original, convincing world, which led us to develop an extensive history and mythology to give the setting depth and internal logic.

Our islands, for example, are designed to feel as authentic and believable as possible, supported by details such as a full 24-hour day-and-night cycle. As players explore the islands and towns, we want them to feel that these are real, lived-in places. Within that grounded world, they will also encounter many strange and imaginative elements; but everything exists naturally within the setting and follows its own consistent logic.
IGN: The game operates on a "set sail, explore, collect, return" rhythm. How does Orbtopia function as part of this loop?

Alfie: Orbtopia plays a central role in this loop. The game is divided into two interconnected layers: the ever-changing voyages at sea and Orbtopia, the safe haven of this ocean world. Players repeatedly set sail from the city and return with the spoils of their adventures. The bounty sent back during a voyage can be put to use in Orbtopia to develop your crew, upgrade your ship, and strengthen your overall capabilities. This progression allows you to venture farther, overcome more difficult challenges, and return with even greater rewards on future voyages.
IGN: With the game’s turn-based combat, how players will need to adapt from one run to the next?

Alfie: To support a wide variety of builds, our combat system needed to accommodate a large number of skills and a meaningful degree of randomness. After extensive testing and iteration, we ultimately chose turn-based combat because it allows us to fully express the freedom and variety of the game’s roguelike build system.

We have also integrated roguelike elements directly into the turn-based combat system, including a dice mechanic that can grant characters an additional action. This adds unpredictability to each encounter while creating more opportunities for strategic decision-making and interactions between different mechanics. Once players reach a certain level, some weaker enemies can be defeated through simplified real-time combat instead. This allows players to focus more of their attention on major boss encounters and exploring the wider world.
IGN: How do you strike a balance between roguelike elements and a longer progression system?

Alfie: Voyage-specific builds provide a faster and more dramatic sense of growth within each run, while progression in Orbtopia establishes a lasting foundation. During each voyage, players can shape their team through a variety of build choices, creating powerful combinations and synergies. These choices are varied and flexible, ensuring that every voyage carries an element of uncertainty. However, a team’s performance at sea is also built upon the permanent progression achieved in Orbtopia. If players encounter an especially difficult opponent, they can return to the city to strengthen their characters’ core abilities, better preparing them for future challenges in the wider world.
Sea of Remnants Creative Director confirms the game will feature customization and accommodate various play styles.
IGN: How will the game accommodate different playstyles?

Alfie: Players can follow the main story to explore our major islands at a steady pace. Along the way, they will learn about the characters, discover the nature of this world, and experience the details that make it feel rich and believable. Alternatively, players can embark on the Forgotten Voyage, quickly identify their next objective, and head directly into a new challenge. There are many different ways to experience the game, and players can choose what suits them at any given moment.
IGN: How deep does customization go?

Alfie: We believe emotional attachment develops naturally through repeated voyages and the time players spend refining and mastering each character. Using the same crew member across different classes and builds can produce entirely different combat styles. Discovering those possibilities and making them work creates a sense of accomplishment shared between the player and the character, while also deepening the player’s understanding of that crew member. We are also continuing to expand each character’s story and related content, giving players more opportunities to form lasting connections with their crew beyond combat and progression.

news.title: Paradox's next grand strategy game is taking cues from Fallout and Mad Max
news.summary: Afterworld will let you conquer post-apocalyptic North America.

content.v: Paradox Development Studio is taking a break from conquering history and space, setting its sights instead on post-apocalyptic North America. Afterworld will see you take control of a tribe of survivors as you explore and conquer the ruins of the fallen continent. Which you might already know, after yesterday's leak. But now it's official!

Afterworld was just revealed during Gamescom's Opening Night Live, with a trailer that's evocative of both Fallout and Mad Max. Paradox has naturally put its own spin on things, however, with features like the Ancients, immortal leaders who existed before the collapse of civilisation, and who are now fighting to rule what's left using forgotten technology. They might cause some problems for you.

Like Stellaris, you'll be able to pick your tribe's origins, including a Fallout-inspired start that sees you leaving the safety of your bunker to begin a new life in the wasteland. There's a survival bent to the proceedings, with your tribe needing to scrounge up the bare necessities like food and water before it can start thriving. Unlike previous PDX games, you really are starting from scratch.

Eventually you'll be able to rebuild civilisation or create something completely new, founding new religions, establishing laws, and taking advantage of pre-Fall technology, like that big ol' spider robot from the trailer. With convoys you'll be able to set up trading routes and supply lines to keep your new civilisation ticking, and if things get too rough you can leave your home behind and migrate to a new land, or just become nomads or raiders.

Afterworld seems to be shaping up to be Paradox's most exploration-heavy grand strategy game—even when compared to Stellaris. Take the ideas tree, for instance. This is essentially your tech tree, and it's based entirely on what your tribe experiences.

Instead of seeing the whole tree laid out in front of you, or getting a random selection of techs to choose from, the tree is revealed through exploration. If your tribe encounters a river, you'll learn about irrigation, unlocking the appropriate idea in the tree. If you meet another tribe and they've established a religion, then you'll discover the organised religion idea.

This is also where the procedural generation can shake things up. While the terrain and geography are immutable, you'll encounter different tribes, resources and dangers when you start a new run. So you'll always be able to find that river and unlock irrigation, but other experiences will be random.

Afterworld's development is being led by Dan Lind, formerly game director on Hearts of Iron 4. But there seems to be plenty of concepts drawn from Paradox's other grand strategy games as well. I've mentioned Stellaris a couple of times already, but it looks like there's plenty of Crusader Kings DNA in here too. Even though you're running a tribe rather than inhabiting an individual ruler, it still seems like there are some RPG nods.

"Afterworld is Paradox’s first non-historical setting in a decade, and I can’t wait to see what stories our players will tell with it,” says Lind. "This is the first world we’ve gotten to build from scratch in a long time, and the first one we've had the pleasure of destroying before the game starts. The old world is still out there in fragments, waiting to be found. What comes after it is entirely up to the players."

I know a lot of PDX fans were hoping for a Stellaris-like fantasy game for the developer's next outing, but we've already got so many fantasy-themed 4X games—the post-apocalypse strikes me as a more novel GSG setting.
A couple of weeks ago I got to go hands-on with Afterworld, so keep an eye out for my preview soon.

news.title: The hardware crisis has hit a new low: We're now using rats for RAM
news.summary: Rat computer.

content.v: Good news from the near future: Space travel has apparently advanced enough to allow humanity to establish a hotel on the surface of the moon.

Bad news: The RAMpocalypse apparently continues unabated, forcing novel experimentation with alternate forms of computer memory not rendered wholly unaffordable by AI datacenters. Namely, rat computers.

This believable projection of the current miserable state of consumer hardware comes courtesy of Ontos, the next game from Amnesia developer Frictional Games. In the trailer above, a man strapped to a chair with electrodes stuck in his head is a bit freaky, though less so than another guy who's missing everything from his upper teeth down; perhaps humanity in the future is so desperate for localized processing power that we're resorting to shoving DisplayPort cables into our brains, too.

The strongest big of imagery in the trailer by far, though, is a computer the size of a wall with 60 rats connected to it in sequence. Or parallel? I'm not great on my circuitry fundamentals, but I know a rat computer when I see one.
I am instinctively scared of the rat computer and the unknown potential of 60 rat minds taking the place of random access asiago memory.
My fear is apparently warranted, given the ominous question posed in the trailer's YouTube description is as follows:
"Do you follow the instructions given through the rodent machine?
Do you seek an alternative approach?
Or simply sabotage the experiment to satisfy your own morbid curiosity?"

The description claims there is "no right or wrong solution in Ontos," but I think the subtext is clear: We must do whatever possible to avoid this future coming to pass. Let's call off this whole AI thing before the next hardware generation arrives, lest Dire Digital Rattus 6 become the only memory accepted by motherboards by the year 2030.
Assuming we even have that much time. Ontos is out next year, and might be a banger; we loved Frictional's last game, Amnesia: The Bunker, scoring it a 93% .

news.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Gets New Trailer at Gamescom 2026 Showing off Submarine Combat, Weapons, and More
news.summary: Fans were treated to a new Final Fantasy 7 Revelation trailer at Gamescom’s Opening Night Live showcase, where

others.title: Ananta’s New Trailer Goes Hard On Memes

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/final-fantasy-vii-revelations-trailer-gamescom-1787690049518.jpg
Fans were treated to a new Final Fantasy 7 Revelation trailer at Gamescom’s Opening Night Live showcase, where we saw more of The Weapons, a submarine combat section, and more.

The trailer opens up with Rufus Shinra sharing a public service announcement on the Shinra News Network regarding the looming Meteor and the Weapons, assuring citizens that humanity will “reign supreme” over these obstacles.
We get to see one of these Weapons wreaking havoc on Shinra soldiers, as well as special shots of the Ruby Weapon, Emerald Weapon, and the Ultima Weapon.

Gameplay footage showing Tifa wearing the Black Mage class outfit was is shown off, as well as a prerendered cutscene showing the Highwind facing off with a Weapon. We even get to see the inside of the submarine with the Huge Materia smack in the middle, along with an underwater combat section that shows the party navigating through the ocean as the submarine dodges attacks.

Footage of the team parachuting down from the Highwind and riding chocobos through the world is also included, as well as Yuffie exploring what seems to be Wutai, making for an extremely hype trailer that is leaving fans more excited than ever.
Most of the dialogue in the trailer centered around the Weapons, with Vincent Valentine explaining in a voiceover that "the Planet sees us as another threat to her well-being, and rightfully so."
"You call 'em planetary warriors," Cid says. "But I call 'em weapons of mass destruction!"

It remains to be seen if these featured Weapons will be normal bosses or super bosses, in keeping with the original game. Unfortunately, no specific release date was revealed, either. Spring 2027 is still the ongoing release window for the game, which will release simultaneously on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (via Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox PC.

This is the latest look we've gotten at FFVII Revelation following the trailers that were shown at Summer Game Fest earlier this year, where we were reintroduced to the Highwind. Using the airship, Cloud and company will be able to traverse all across the planet, dropping down via parachutes to explore to your heart's content.

It also introduced the FITS system, which allows each character to change their playstyle based on Final Fantasy jobs. Speaking of gameplay, yes, you'll get the chance to play the gunslinging Vincent Valentine and even transform into the Galian Beast.

As yet, not much else has been revealed about the game, but director Naoki Hamaguchi has publicly stated that he wants to integrate many of the Final Fantasy VII spin-off properties into its ultimate ending.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

content.v: 在今天的科隆游戏展开幕夜上，《TARAE: The Unbound》正式公布。本作是一款以东方暗黑奇幻世界为背景的俯视角动作RPG，玩家将踏上神秘岛屿，在六大领域破碎的边界之间展开冒险。
游戏预告：
游戏中，玩家将扮演六名各自背负不同因果与使命的“求道者”（暂译），他们拥有截然不同的战斗风格和成长路线。玩家可以从六大独特职业中选择角色，并通过职业技能、特性、辅助技能以及装备自由组合BD，打造属于自己的战斗方式。
战斗是《TARAE: The Unbound》的核心内容。玩家可以使用大量技能与连锁攻击，在敌群中展开高速战斗，同时需要观察强大敌人的攻击模式，通过闪避、反击等方式寻找突破口。游戏还特别强调打击反馈，希望让每一次攻击都具有足够的力量感。
除了大量普通敌人外，本作还准备了强调学习和掌握机制的Boss战。面对强大的Boss，玩家需要熟悉其攻击规律，在关键时刻完成闪避与反击，并利用自身构筑寻找击败对手的方法。

剧情方面，六名求道者将踏上彼此交织的旅程，在一次次试炼中逐渐理解彼此，并最终成为真正的伙伴。游戏世界则融合了东方神话、民间传说与传统美学，打造出一个美丽却又充满黑暗与残酷气息的幻想世界。
玩家所探索的岛屿诞生于六大领域破碎的边界之上，随着冒险深入，不同的选择与战斗都将影响恢复六界秩序的道路。

news.title: Gravhounds Reveal Trailer Sends Good Boys Into A Sci-Fi Battle
news.summary: Gamescom Opening Night Live is always full of surprises, and this year, indie developer Octopus Panic made a s

content.v: Gamescom Opening Night Live is always full of surprises, and this year, indie developer Octopus Panic made a splash with a first look at its new action-builder game Gravhounds. As seen in the reveal trailer below, Gravhounds takes place in a future where interstellar exploration and colonization have become the domain of man's best friend.

Although the trailer states that the titular Gravhounds have been "bred" for this life, their humanoid appearance suggests more than a little genetic engineering was responsible for this turn of events. In fact, there's no sign of human life at all on this hostile alien world, but the Gravhounds themselves seem human enough.

The gameplay supports 1-4 players as they attempt to build up resources for a new colony while holding on to the potential promise of coming home. Upgrades appear to play a major role in the main characters' survival, especially when they get overwhelmed by alien forces that really don't want them around at all.

According to Gravhounds' Steam page , the game's early-access period will last at least six months. It will "include the core Gravhound experience," but we plan to expand its breadth, depth, and replayability on the road to 1.0," reads the statement. Both solo and co-op campaigns will be playable during this initial release.
Gravhounds' early-access release will hit Xbox Series X|S and PC on November 2. It will also be available on day one with Xbox Game Pass.

news.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Is Adding Dozens Of Upgrades And It Might Be Free For You
news.summary: It may not be The Witcher 4 , but the first real look at The Witcher 3's new DLC, Songs of the Past, might jus

content.v: It may not be The Witcher 4 , but the first real look at The Witcher 3's new DLC, Songs of the Past, might just make the wait a little easier, especially when it's coming soon after a free upgrade to The Witcher 3 Remastered, as was newly revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live .

Developer CD Projekt Red showed off the upcoming expansion (just don't call it DLC ) as part of Gamescom Opening Night Live, revealing new details about the over-a-decade-later expansion coming to The Witcher 3.

But this came after the reveal of the game's remastered version, whose changes and additions were numerous, including improved controls, a skill tree revamp, expanded photo mode, both past expansions, and tons more. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered launches on September 29 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and it's free if you already own The Witcher 3.
All announced changes for The Witcher 3 Remastered
The expansion, Songs of the Past, will follow sometime next year as the third story expansion to the 2015 game.

Songs of the Past has been described as being similar in size and scope to The Witcher 3's previous two expansions, Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine. It's currently slated to release in 2027 but was orginally planned for 2026 .

There are still plenty of questions about Songs of the Past, namely how it might connect to the events of The Witcher 4, which will star Ciri instead of Geralt. CD Projekt Red recently confirmed The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release .

news.title: Cyberpunk 2077’s Sequel Is Years Away, But No Law Might Fill The Gap
news.summary: From the stage of Gamescom Opening Night Live , No Law brought out the cyberpunk flair during a stage show tha

content.v: From the stage of Gamescom Opening Night Live , No Law brought out the cyberpunk flair during a stage show that was often dominated by anime games, dark fantasy souls-likes, and cozy offerings. There's nothing cozy in No Law, though fans of Cyberpunk 2077 will find aesthetics that seem familiar.

While No Law looks a lot like Cyberpunk 2077 when all hell breaks loose, it should be noted that such is the main attraction of Neon Giant's follow-up to The Ascent, as No Law is said to be a first-person shooter, not an RPG.
No Law is set for release in 2027 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X.

news.title: Path Of Exile 2 Is Finally Getting Its Full Release, And It’ll Be Free-To-Play
news.summary: Path of Exile 2 debuted a new gameplay trailer during Gamescom Opening Night Live , which revealed that the ac

content.v: Path of Exile 2 debuted a new gameplay trailer during Gamescom Opening Night Live , which revealed that the action-role-playing sequel will finally launch out of early access on December 11.

The latest gameplay trailer offers a snippet of the sequel's narrative setup, as well as a look at its faster action compared to its predecessor. Like the first game, Path of Exile 2 will offer incredibly deep class customization through hundreds of active and passive skill gems, with a deep emphasis on endgame content that will be composed of over 100 maps and grueling boss fights.

Path of Exile 2 entered early access in December 2024 across PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5. Participating in early builds of the game wasn't free, but developer Grinding Gear Games has confirmed that the game will be going free-to-play when it does launch into 1.0 later this year.

If you're already playing Path of Exile 2 or want to get the most out of it when it does launch, you can sign up on the game's official mailing list and receive exclusive in-game rewards in the lead-up to release.
If December is too far away, Diablo IV's latest expansion launched earlier this year and continues to expand on Blizzard's role-playing epic in all the rights ways.

news.title: All Anyone At Gamescom Can Talk About Is Dolly Parton
news.summary: This year's Gamescom Opening Night Live ceremony just came to an end, and the livestreamed showcase had no sho

content.v: This year's Gamescom Opening Night Live ceremony just came to an end, and the livestreamed showcase had no shortage of highly anticipated announcements and trailers. From a closer look at the upcoming Witcher 3 DLC and the announcement of two PUBG spin-offs, to new glimpses of Control: Resonant , Silent Hill: Townfall , and Final Fantasy 7 Revelation , ONL seemed to have something for everyone. There was even a live performance of a track from the Mewgenics soundtrack.

But between demands for a new Path of Exile 2 trailer (which finally materialized 90 minutes into the showcase) and random declarations of "GTA 6!!!," one message kept popping up in the showcase's live Twitch chat: #RIPDOLLY.
Just moments into the live broadcast, country singer and pop culture icon Dolly Parton's death was announced via an Instagram post shared by her nephew and head of security, Bryan Seaver.

Parton passed away at 80, after decades of smash country hits and admirable charitable giving. Aside from appearing in several casino games, Parton had very little to do with gaming, her biggest contributions being her 2020 collaboration with Word With Friends and the inclusion of her songs "9 to 5" and "Odd Jobs" in 2009's Pop'n Music for the Nintendo Wii. (Though she did appear in her own pinball machine in 1979 .)

But despite her lack of deep connections to the world of gaming, homages to Parton continued to flood the chat even as Gamescom's opening showcase entered its second hour. And in his announcement of her death, Parton's nephew Bryan Seaver explained things perfectly.

"My family and I have shared a lifetime of beautiful memories with Dolly, but so have you," he said. "She has always been on your television, your record player, your CD and on your phone playlist, becoming an extended part of your family whether you liked it or not. Our family and the team she has entrusted with her legacy will work diligently to ensure her spirit will live with us forever. Dolly was a farmer, just like her daddy; he farmed the soil, [while] she farmed songs and happiness."

Perhaps that's the essence of it. Parton connected with everyone--not just country music lovers or fans of her many films. Like games themselves, Parton was a fond part of many of our childhoods. Her charisma was so strong that her memory managed to steal the show at a gaming showcase held half a world away from her home in Tennessee, where her family says she passed peacefully.

news.title: Gears of War: E-Day Campaign Hands-On Preview: To Quote Marcus Fenix, “Nice”
news.summary: I’m now not only more fired up to finish Gears of War: E-Day’s prequel story than ever, but I’m also more conf

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/22/gowed-blogroll-1787358129687.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:
[ Editor's Note : Mild spoilers ahead for E-Day’s campaign, so turn back now if you don’t want to know any more…]

I’m a massive fan of Gears of War, as I have been since the very beginning. But I have to be honest: something about Gears of War: E-Day’s campaign reveal at the Xbox Showcase a couple months ago just didn’t quite land right with me. It wasn’t bad, by any stretch of the imagination. But I just wasn’t as fired up as I thought I’d be after seeing the first new Gears of War campaign footage in seven years (OK, six if we’re counting Hivebusters).

When I finally sat down to play E-Day’s campaign, though, it took all of about 30 seconds to turn my tepid feelings into joyful smiles. My one-hour preview, which covered the early parts of Act 2, featured plenty of everything I want from and love about Gears of War: Marcus Fenix, Dominic Santiago, lots of story cutscenes, a sweet mix of old weapons and new ones (including the origin story for a signature Gears firearm known for its sharp teeth), some evolved gameplay mechanics, killer setpieces, new Marcus Fenix one-liners, subtle references to characters we know and love, and did I mention Marcus Fenix saying and doing cool sh*t?

I was so fired up by what I played that when I got hit with the “demo complete” screen it actually hurt. I suppose The Coalition got the reaction it wanted from me, because all I wanted to do was keep going. And I’m now not only more fired up to finish Gears of War: E-Day’s prequel story than ever, but I’m also more confident than ever that, at least based on the small slice I’ve played so far, E-Day has struck the exact right balance of tried-and-true old stuff and compelling new stuff.
Playing Bridge

Act 2 picks up with Marcus and Dom still in their civvies, scavenged Mark-1 Lancers in hand. They’ve arrived with fellow civilian-dressed COG soldiers Carter and Reyes at a makeshift command center with the mayor of Kolona, whom they’ve no doubt rescued in Act 1. COG officer Colonel Trench and the mayor face off about whatever the heck is happening out there – you and I both know darn well what it is, of course – and how best to handle it, leading the angry Colonel to yell at our heroes to get some armor on. And then Awesome Moment #1 happens: Marcus and Dom suit up in their familiar COG garb, flanked by Carter and Reyes in the newly christened Bravo Squad. “Guess we’re back to it,” Marcus says, and he might as well be speaking for players as well. My grin could not have been any wider.

Venturing out into the city of Kolona, we see ash raining from a cloudy sky and remnants of once-proud buildings around us. This moment definitely hearkens back to the “destroyed beauty” aesthetic of Gears 1. We soon find our way to the heart of this chapter of gameplay: a massive suspension bridge that raises and lowers in multiple sections in order to let large ships pass underneath it. All of that was in the Before Times, of course, before actual Hell started erupting from the ground beneath the people of this city. We’re making our way towards Oria Stadium, home of the Kolona Eagles thrashball team, where civilians are being routed to in the event of the citywide disaster. But we’re going to have to fight our way there.
Combat Evolved

This straight-ahead bridge section certainly isn’t the combat bowls we’re used to with Gears, but it’s a great way to warm up – not to mention climb up, meaning: to get a feel for using E-Day’s new verticality, i.e. you can now mantle up and over cover, including the cars that the Locust are using to shield themselves. The Mark-1 Lancer, Gnasher shotgun, Snub pistol, and frag grenades all work exactly as you remember them. Gears of War’s core combat has aged remarkably well over the past 20 years. However, E-Day introduces a welcome new evolution in the form of unlockable weapon mods. Each firearm has four total mod slots, and mods vary by weapon, of course. Every reloadable weapon, by default, gets the classic damage bonus if you nail a perfect reload; it’s called Full Metal Jacket now. But there’s a heck of a lot more than just that. For instance, on the aforementioned Gnasher – which, yes, is still your best point-blank bet for turning low-level Locust Drones into chunky-style soup – has an Auto Pouch mod that automatically reloads the shotgun when you stow it (i.e. switch weapons).

This also seems like a good time to mention the new Tactical Gear, which I unlocked at the very end of my demo build. (You got to experience these in the Versus beta weekend, if you participated.) These are short-duration (45-second) buffs with a cooldown, and they also have unlockable mod slots, none of which were available in the preview. But even without mods, the Adrenaline Injector immediately refills your health when triggered and also increases your damage dealt while decreasing damage taken. Choosing the Sonic Disruptor Tactical Gear, meanwhile, nets you a more defensive bonus: stunning low-level enemies in a cone in front of you, interrupting their attacks. With tons more of all of these left to unlock over the course of the campaign, they should add a welcome bit of personalization and gameplay customization to your playthroughs – emphasis on plural there, because I’ll be shocked if there isn’t a New Game+ available that lets you run the campaign again with all of your Tactical Gear and weapon mods available from the jump on higher difficulties.
Revved Up

After battling our way up and across the massive Allfather’s Legacy Bridge, including fending off a couple of Boomers along the way and getting some reps in with the Breechshot (last seen in Gears of War: Judgment), we arrived at Oria Stadium, where the COG was coordinating a stressful civilian rescue operation, with lines of the city’s residents waiting to be processed and allowed into the massive facility. We entered and caught up with the quartermaster, Russ, who took a liking to Marcus because he knew his father, Adam. He asked what Bravo Squad needed, and after Marcus complained about the bayonets easily breaking off of the Mark-1 Lancers, that’s when one of the COG in our party set the chainsaw used to save Marcus’ life in Act 1, as seen in the Xbox Showcase demo, on the table. The quartermaster looks at the chainsaw with a twinkle in his eye, and, yeah…you can probably see where this is going. Awesome Moment #2: Marcus and Bravo Squad get handed the first prototype Mark-2 Lancers with chainsaw built right in. Again, the smile on my face was almost Joker-like.

We headed out from the stadium with the goal of getting across the downtown section of the city to the train station. It’s here that Awesome Moment #3 began to unfold: environmental freedom. The linear path of the bridge we’d fought across had finally given way to a larger combat space. This seems to deliberately rein in Gears 5’s huge open-world areas by instead giving you room to clear Kalona’s streets block-by-block in whatever order and fashion you choose. It’s a smaller-scale version of what we got in the last game, but based on my initial impression, it’s a more effective one. In fact, I ran through the preview build again to take a different route through Kolona, and I’m glad I did. This approach also allows for higher hidden-collectible potential (because yes, of course there are collectibles in a Gears campaign). I also enjoyed the optional secondary objectives in this section that you can opt into. In one, a family was trapped inside a convenience store, and I had to fight off a wave of Wretches before finding a way inside to free them and radio in to get them an escort to the stadium.

news.title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons Doesn’t Seem Too Concerned With The “D&D” Part Of Its Title
news.summary: After nearly a year of silence, Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons has reemerged to give sword and sorcery fans a fir

content.v: After nearly a year of silence, Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons has reemerged to give sword and sorcery fans a first look at its third-person gameplay. Warlock's gameplay reveal came during Gamescom Opening Night Live , and featured a lengthy trailer showcasing how the game's spell-slinging combat will work.

Based on its latest trailer, Warlock forgoes sticking to the same formula many D&D-based adventure games tend to use, placing an emphasis on spells and combat rather than roleplay and replicating the tabletop experience. This might not appeal to those seeking a more traditional D&D-like experience--or those who are baffled by main character Katri's seemingly infinite spell slots--but its dark fantasy visuals, snappy spellcasting, and Witcher-esque gameplay certainly look fun.

In addition to a first look at gameplay, the trailer also gave us a bit more information regarding the game's setting. It seems as though Warlock will follow Katri's journey through Ravenloft's Domains of Dread. Darkon, the largest and most powerful of these domains, was seen in the trailer; we can only hope that a Darklord Azalin appearance will follow.

Warlock was announced during the 2025 The Game Awards via a stylish heavy metal trailer that spotlighted the game's main character, Katri. In an interview last year, developer Invoke Studios said players will always play as Katri, but may meet other characters and form alliances with them while adventuring.

Earlier this year, it was announced that Maggie Robertson--best known for her performances as Lady Dimitrescu in Resident Evil: Village and Orin the Red in Baldur's Gate 3--would be joining Warlock as Tasha, a Dungeons & Dragons icon whom fans are likely familiar with. Known also as Iggwilv, Zybilna, and The Witch Queen, Tasha is the creator of a Domain of Delight, Prismeer, and one of the universe's most powerful archfey. In Warlock, Tasha serves as Katri's patron, granting her immense power in exchange for obedience.
This isn't Invoke's first stab at a D&D adventure. The studio, formerly Tuque Studios, was also behind 2021's not exactly well-received D&D: Dark Alliance reboot.
Warlock is slated for a 2027 release.

news.title: Metro 2039 Explores The Horror Humans Can Commit In Latest Gameplay Trailer
news.summary: The Metro games have never shied away from shoving players into a bleak post-apocalyptic world, but in Metro 2

content.v: The Metro games have never shied away from shoving players into a bleak post-apocalyptic world, but in Metro 2039, things are looking especially grim. Ahead of its release in 2027, a new gameplay trailer for Metro 2039 was revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live , showing how players will have to deal with a new regime that has risen from the ashes of the nuclear war that turned the world into a radioactive wasteland.

The gameplay showcased several hallmarks of the Metro's distinct action. These include dangerous metro tunnels filled with soldiers, monsters inhabiting the radiation-filled surface, and the many, many guns you'll have to dispatch them with. Like previous entries, you'll be able to craft weapons to suit your playstyle, with the gameplay showcasing an aggressive approach to the series' stealth action.

While Metro 2039 still features mutated monsters and ghouls, it seems 4A Games is focusing more on the atrocities humans can commit in this sequel. As described by developers on stage at Opening Night Live, Metro 2039 is about consequences: the cost of silence, the horror of tyranny, the price of freedom. It is clear the studio is drawing from its experience of developing the sequel while enduring the ongoing war in Ukraine.

Metro 2039 features a new protagonist , known as the Stranger . A new power has risen in the form of the Spartan Order, which has evolved from a force for good in the older Metro games into a twisted, authoritarian movement known as the Novareich. Led by Hunter--the very same Spartan Ranger from Metro 2033--the Stranger comes out of exile and embarks on a journey through the remains of Moscow to take down the Novareich and Hunter, its Führer.

Developer 4A Games says that Metro 2039 will be a shocking entry in the series: one where players will have to master exploration, survival, combat, and stealth skills to stand a chance at seeing the Stranger's mission through to the end. Despite being a sequel to the original trilogy, 4A Games says this will be an ideal point to jump in if you haven't yet, too. Metro 2039 launches for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S in February 2027.

news.title: NBA 2K27 Teases GTA 6 Crossover Of Some Kind
news.summary: 2K Sports has released a new trailer for NBA 2K27 today, and it features a reference to GTA 6 that is promptin

content.v: 2K Sports has released a new trailer for NBA 2K27 today, and it features a reference to GTA 6 that is prompting people to theorize about what it may mean. The Season 1 trailer for NBA 2K27 does a lot more than just show off what's coming in Season 1--it also hints at Seasons 2 and 3.

As you can see in the trailer below, the imagery and styling for Season 3 is plainly referencing GTA 6 with its palm trees, font, and colors. Police sirens can be heard as well, which is another nod to GTA.
The video doesn't specifically state when NBA 2K27's Season 3 will begin. However, it does confirm that Season 2 starts October 16.
If seasons are as long as they have historically be in the past, that would mean Season 3 could start around the end of November. And that lines up nicely with GTA 6's release on November 19.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-25-at-2.26.27-PM-1.png?w=636

This isn't the first time that GTA 6 and basketball have been connected. One of the GTA 6 gameplay leaks showed main character Jason dribbling a basketball and shooting hoops at his house, with many taking this to mean basketball will be a minigame of sorts in GTA 6.
That seems like a safe bet, as does GTA 6 crossing over with NBA 2K27 in some capacity. Take-Two, which owns Rockstar and 2K, might see a rising tide lifting all ships, after all.

news.title: Game Of Thrones: War For Westeros Will Let The White Walkers Win
news.summary: It's still going to be a while before Game of Thrones: War for Westeros arrives, but at Gamescom Opening Night

content.v: It's still going to be a while before Game of Thrones: War for Westeros arrives, but at Gamescom Opening Night Live , developer Playside showed off some gameplay to make the wait a little bit easier.

First announced in 2025--and originally scheduled for a 2026 launch--Game of Thrones: War for Westeros is a real-time strategy game that features several of the franchise's legendary Houses--Lannister, Stark, and Targaryen--as well as the sinister forces of the Night King. With each faction vying to take control of the Seven Kingdoms, it's up to players to command their armies and lead them to victory.

Hero units look to play a major role in War for Westeros' RTS gameplay, with characters like Tywin Lannister, Jon Snow, and others shown to have special abilities that can turn the tide of battle. And Daenerys Targaryen, of course, has a dragon, which seems like it will be more than a little overpowered.

The trailer gives a glimpse of this, and how players will be able to rewrite Game of Thrones history. At one point Robb Stark can be seen cutting down Jamie Lannister before later approaching the Iron Throne. Someone must have warned him about the Red Wedding. It also teases what the ending of Game of Thrones may have looked like had the White Walkers won, with the end of the trailer showing the Night King sitting on the throne triumphantly.

The final season of Game of Thrones back in 2019 is largely remembered now as one of the greatest fumbles in the history of television, so it will be interesting to see how War for Westeros will let players change events to their liking. Don't like the fact that Bran the Broken was seemingly chosen at random to sit the Iron Throne? Now you can choose who wins, and (hopefully) create a more satisfying ending than the one from the show.

Designed to be a nod to classic RTS games, War for Westeros features a single-player campaign and multiplayer modes for when you want to test your skills against real players across the world. After being out of the limelight for many years, real-time strategy games appear to be making a soft comeback, as Battle for Westeros follows in the wake of several other popular games in the genre, like Age of Empires 4 , Age of Mythology: Retold , and Homeworld 3 .

Upcoming titles like Stronghold 4 and Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 also suggest that there's still a healthy appetite for old-school strategy games. Currently, the Game of Thrones series is owned and controlled by Warner Bros. Discovery, but that could all change if Paramount succeeds in its $100 billion bid to acquire the company.

For now, Game of Thrones remains a key pillar for Warner Bros. Discovery, alongside Harry Potter, Mortal Kombat, and the DC Comics portfolio that includes famous IP like Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman.
